newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: CRICKET-BOLAND WIN TOSS AND BOWL AGAINST TRANSVAAL.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-BOLAND WIN TOSS AND BOWL AGAINST TRANSVAAL.

text.p: Boland won the toss and put Transvaal into bat on the opening day of the four day Supersport Series match at the Wanderers. Play began at 1 p.m. because of overnight rain.
Transval: Adam Bacher, Mark Benfield, Neil McKenzie, Ken Rutherford (captain), Dean Laing, Nic Pothas, Ross Veenstra, Andrew Hall, Clive Eksteen, Trevor Webster, Wayne Kidwell.
Boland: Lloyd Ferreira, Elmar Liebenberg, Wayne Truter, Kenny Jackson, Adrian Kuiper (captain), Billy Stelling, Riaan Oosthuizen, Roger Telemachus, David Millns, Claude Henderson, Charl Willoughby.
